description: Bounded public disposition for the utilization-first representation research: the four-arm unpack probe at a real expert shape (297.6 / 229.7 / 188.8 / 169.3 GB/s as the representation becomes harder to unpack), the modelled per-weight ALU estimates, the pc4 candidate as a projection only, the GSQ and RCO prior art, and the modelled Flash-Next compression target. The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_name: Alice expert geometry for the unpack probe; Qwen3.8 Flash-Next byte budget for the modelled target
model_revision: campaign artifacts; no weight payload or activation capture is part of this repository
model_download_source: public model cards exist; no weight payload is part of this repository
quant_name: int8-resident, packed 4-bit 4.5 bpw, 4.25 bpw symmetric, 4.25 bpw affine (probe arms)
hardware_phenotype: RX9060XT16-NITRO-GFX1200-RADV-2026.08.27-v1; RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; INT8-WMMA probe at a real expert shape
gpu_configuration: RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; INT8-WMMA probe at a real expert shape
prompt: not applicable; the probe holds the output fixed and varies the representation
warmup: repeated passes; the probe is a same-shape comparison

expected_range.pc4: projection only; no measured throughput exists
expected_range.preserved_negative: compact expert formats at 4.25-4.27 bpw: documented negative; 2.0-2.25 bpw quality-fatal

tolerance.unpack_probe: single-shape kernel measurement; not an end-to-end speedup

known_limitations: The pc4 performance is a projection; nothing about it is measured.
No GSQ, RCO, or combined implementation exists in this repository.
The Flash-Next 40-56 GB and 2.25-2.5 bpw figures are projections from another model's ratios.
Quality is not weight-MSE; the capability gate list is proposed and not yet run.
